inputs.wildcard_text:
A beautiful fit {Russian|French|German|South Korean|Dutch|Swiss|American|Swedish|Austrian|Ukrainian|Portuguese} woman is performing a magic trick.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic video. A static medium-wide shot frames the person standing naturally in a {modern  open concept living room|cluttered bedroom|theatre stage in front of red curtains|penthouse loft apartment} wearing {candy-raver gear with phat pants and lots of colorful bead jewelry|short shorts and a tight top|a long black skirt and dress shirt|tight jean shorts and a front-tie blouse|{red|purple|teal|yellow|blue|orange|colorful|white|beige|skin-colored|pink|peach} yoga pants and a matching {crop top|sports bra|active shirt|bikini top}|a white blouse, blue vest and blue plaid skirt}, A blanket lies on the floor directly in front of them.

During the first three seconds, the person bends naturally at the waist and knees, reaches down with both hands, grasps the blanket, and smoothly stands back up while lifting it. They quickly raise the blanket upward in front of their body until it extends above their head and completely hides their entire body from the camera. By approximately 4 seconds, the person is fully concealed behind the blanket.

For a brief moment the blanket completely blocks the person from view. While they are fully hidden, their clothing changes invisibly behind the blanket; there is no visible morphing or clothing transformation before they are completely obscured.

The person immediately releases and drops the blanket downward. As the blanket falls below their shoulders and body, the same person is revealed wearing {a {red|purple|teal|yellow|blue|orange|colorful|white|beige|skin-colored|pink|peach} bikini|jogging pants and a sweatshirt|a tight {red|purple|teal|yellow|blue|orange|colorful|white|beige|skin-colored|pink|peach} dress|a tight {red|purple|teal|yellow|blue|orange|colorful|white|beige|skin-colored|pink|peach} bodysuit| a {red|purple|teal|yellow|blue|orange|colorful|white|beige|skin-colored|pink|peach} leotard}, creating the appearance of an instantaneous stage-magic clothing change. Their identity, face, hairstyle, body proportions, position in the room, and the surrounding environment remain unchanged.

By approximately 6 seconds the blanket has fallen completely away from their body and the new outfit is fully visible. For the remainder of the shot, the person remains standing in the same position, briefly looks down at their changed clothes, then looks toward the camera with a pleased, playful expression, presenting the completed magic trick. The blanket settles naturally on the floor. The camera remains completely static throughout the entire video with no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room ambience throughout. Soft fabric rustling accompanies the blanket being picked up and raised, followed by a stronger flutter as it drops and a soft impact as it lands on the floor.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
